rules.name: Lucky
rules.description: Discard this card to re-roll any one die. The second result must be used.

rules.name: Total Air Superiority
rules.description:
Your Force has Fighter Interdiction and Perfect Timing.
Fighter Interdiction: Your opponent must roll a 5+ for their aircraft to arrive (instead of the usual 4+).
Perfect Timing: Discard this card before rolling. When Rolling for Aircraft arrival, your Aircraft arrive on a 3+ (instead of the usual 4+) this turn.

rules.name: Naval Gunfire
rules.description:
Each Shooting Step, choose a Formation HQ Team or an Observer to request a Naval Gunfire bombardment. On a roll of 5+ they may Spot for a four-gun Naval Gunfire Bombardment using their own Skill rating and the following weapon stats:
(See "Naval Gunfire" profile)
Remove the Ranged In marker for this bombardment at the end of the Shooting Step.

sharedRules.name: MRC Body Armour
sharedRules.description: A Team with MRC Body Armour rolls a die when they fail a Save for a Hit from an Artillery Bombardment (after any re-rolls). On a roll of 5+, they are unharmed. On any other roll, they are Destroyed as usual after any necessary Firepower rolls.

sharedRules.name: Close Assault
sharedRules.description: Infantry teams carried as Passengers in a Ram Kangaroo can Dismount in the Assault Step when Charging into Contact. Passengers cannot Assault if the vehicle moved at Dash Speed.

sharedRules.name: One Use
sharedRules.description: A Unit with Tulip can only fire one Artillery Bombardment per game.

sharedRules.name: Saturation Bombardment
sharedRules.description: Each Saturation Bombardment weapon counts as two weapons firing in an Artillery Bombardment.

sharedRules.name: Bunker Killer
sharedRules.description: Bunker Killer Teams can hit Nest and Bunker Teams despite being an Artillery Bombardment. As a Brutal Bombardment, any Infantry, Gun (including Nests and Bunkers), or Unarmoured Tank Teams it hits must re-roll succesful Saves.

sharedRules.name: Petard
sharedRules.description:
When firing a Bombardment with their Petard, AVRE Teams:
-may spot and fire Bombardments even if they moved this turn,
-do not need to re-roll successful To Hit for only having 1 or 2 weapons firing, and
-ignore the Danger Close rule.

sharedRules.name: Mike Target
sharedRules.description: When a Spotting Team successfully Rages In an Artillery Unit with Mike Target, they may immediatly roll to Range In another Artillery Unit. If successful, the additional Artillery Unit is treated as Ranging In on the same attempt as the first.

sharedRules.name: Gigantic
sharedRules.description: Gigantic Units cannot be placed in buildings and cannot be placed from Ambush within 16"/40cm of enemy Teams.

sharedRules.name: Air Observer Post
sharedRules.description:
An Air Observer Post is an Aircraft that arrives on a roll of 3+ (rather than the usual 4+)

An Air Observer Post is unarmed, but can act as an Observer Spotting for an Artillery Bombardment with an Aiming Pont within 12"/30cm of tha Aircraft. The opposing player may shoot at the Aircraft immediately before it rolls to Range In as though the aircraft was Shooting.

sharedRules.name: Airborne
sharedRules.description: This Formation may make an Airborne Assault in missions that use the Airborden Assault rules (page 84)

sharedRules.name: Night Attack
sharedRules.description:
If a Force with Night Attack is the attacker in a mission where the defender has Minefields, the player may attack at night. If they do so, Night Fighting rules (see page 113 of the rulebook) are in effect at the start of the game.

British Units from a Formation with  Night Attack can move freely from the start of the game. Friendly Units from other Formations or Support may not more out of their Deployment Area untill morning breaks.

sharedRules.name: Flame Trailers
sharedRules.description: Flame tanks cannot Charge into Contact and cannot Hold Objectives.

sharedRules.name: Pioneers
sharedRules.description: Pioneers Teams cross Minefields safely on a roll of 2+. If they remain in the Minefield and are not Pinned Down, they may clear the Minefield automatically in their next turn.

rules.name: Staghound
rules.description: All Daimler (2 pdr) armoured cars in this Unit have the armour rating shown and replace their MG weapon with the Staghound (MGs) profile. They do not have the Overworked rule on the 2 pdr.
